maria: Heads up — prod alert: short-seq (<=64) p50 regressed ~15% on a subset of SM92 machines after yesterday's kernel-autotune rollout. Saw a cluster of fallback kernel picks for short paths.

sam: Which kernel exactly fell back? any hint from the cap-detect logs?

maria: Looks like `generic_fallback_v2` for seq<=64. hw sig on one node: SM=92, driver=537.11. capflags printout shows tensorcore=true but bf16=false (seems wrong). Logs: `cap_detect: tc=1 bf16=0 fp8=0` even though hardware should support bf16.

jordan: I repro'd locally on an sm92 test node:

```
$ ./perf_runner --model=gpt --seq=64 --batch=4 --node=sm92
p50: 78ms (baseline 68ms)
p95: 210ms (baseline 195ms)
kernel: generic_fallback_v2
kv-cache hitrate: 89%
```

jordan: KV cache hitrate looks fine but latency up. Kernel selection changed after the new probe change that reordered capability checks.

lee: I think the probe reordering is the root cause — we now check fp8 first and set a superset mask, which can clear the bf16 bit in some driver combos. Suggest adding a small hysteresis: require 2 consecutive probes before flipping the fastpath bit for a given SM family. That will avoid flapping during noisy probe samples. :thinking:

sam: Quick mitigation: we can allow a forced override env `REDWOOD_KERNEL_OVERRIDE=fastpath_sm92_seq64` for the rollout group, and revert the probe change. Also add a unit test that runs `make autotune-test TARGET=sm92 SEQ_CUTOFF=64`.

maria: I'll patch the probe to prefer bf16 if tensor cores present and add the 2-probe hysteresis. Also plan to bump `min_batch_for_fastpath` to 2 when seq<=64 to reduce small-batch thrash. Opening PR now.

ci-bot: autotune-test failed on commit abc123: ERROR:cap_flags:unknown_bit 0x400 at capmap.c:142 — missing mapping for SM92->bf16 flag.

jordan: I'll schedule a fleet run to collect capability histograms across all sm92 hosts overnight and post results in this thread. If we still see KV-cache evictions correlating with regression, we'll adjust prefix TTL — I noticed evict spikes at 03:20 UTC matching the deploy window.

lee: When you collect histograms, include the probe sequence (fp8,bf16,tc) ordering and the probe confidence scores. We'll need an ablation matrix: baseline vs probe-hysteresis vs mapping-fix vs override. Add the matrix to /perf/benchmarks/regression-sm92 so QA can run it.

maria: Sounds good. PR will include: probe mapping fix, 2-probe hysteresis, unit test, and a dashboard metric `kernel_picker_fallback_rate` so we can alert if fallback > 5% for any SM family. I'll keep this thread updated after the overnight run. :wave:
